description: x ≈ A⁺b for a low-rank, well-conditioned A (Gilyén, Lloyd and Tang 2018): the sketch, the needed inner products by the median of means, and x̃ held as a combination of sampled rows; its entries queried, length-squared draws made by rejection, and its inner products with given vectors estimated. Where the reference is made, ‖x̃ − A_k⁺b‖/‖A_k⁺b‖ and the draws' total variation are measured. The answer carries its label: each source theorem's sample count as a formula evaluated at this instance's ‖A‖_F, ‖A‖, σ_k, k, κ, ε, δ and η (exact where the full decomposition was made), its exponents and whether it states its constant, set beside the counts this run used; the error measured against the full decomposition where the matrix is small enough (at most 2^17 entries); and the work counted (entry queries, length-squared samples, random words, the small decomposition's operations). Sealed with the service's key; verify_quantum_result checks the seal and runs it again for the same bits. Refusals: J210, J211.

b.description: The right-hand side: a list of one number a row, or {"range": {"seed", "noise"}} (b = A x₀ for a Gaussian x₀, plus noise of relative norm `noise`; the default, seed 1, no noise).

budget.description: The most rejection proposals the draws make (default: what the job's work bound leaves).

cols_sampled.description: Columns sampled from the sampled rows (default 160).

delta.description: The failure probability the label's theorems are asked for (default 0.1).

epsilon.description: The error the label's theorems are asked for (default 0.1).

eta.description: The width of the singular-value threshold's band the label's theorems take (default 0.2).

inner.description: Vectors to estimate ⟨x̃, y⟩ with: a list of vectors of the matrix's columns' length, or {"gaussian": {"count", "seed"}}.

inner_groups.description: Each inner product's row estimates: the median of means' groups (default 5).

inner_per_group.description: Each inner product's row estimates: the samples in a group (default 500).

k.description: The singular vectors kept (default the generated rank, else 4).

matrix.description: The matrix: {"generate": {"rows", "cols", "rank", "condition", "noise", "seed"}} (a random rank-`rank` matrix, its singular values evenly from 1 down to 1/condition (default 2), plus Gaussian noise whose Frobenius norm is `noise` (default 0.01) of the low-rank part's, from `seed`) or {"entries": [[…], …]} (its rows). At most 2^20 entries.

per_group.description: The samples in each group's mean (default 2000).

reference.description: Hold the answer to the full decomposition where the matrix is small enough (at most 2^17 entries, a smaller side of at most 256; default true).

rows_sampled.description: Rows sampled by their squared norms (default 160).

seed.description: The kernel's seed (default 1): the same seed and request give the same bits on every host.

anyOf.description: A dequantized linear-algebra job's answer as every host gives it (engine::dequant; wai-quantum lab dequant): the request, and the result sealed in a job's form, so wai-quantum verify checks its seal and runs it again for the same bits. A length-squared low-rank approximation (lowrank), a recommendation sample (recommend) or a low-rank linear system's answer (regress), each with its label: the source theorems' sample counts evaluated at this instance beside the counts used, the error measured against the full decomposition where it is computable, and the work counted; or a dequant job checked (check).
